player_prompt.intro:
Owe uli na kubala {difficulty} RushHour. Sungula mabalenge ya kutambulisha masemo ya motoka ya mbwaki [X] na kuyikimbisa kwa kubala kwa kulia.
Mikimbio: [A+], [B-], n.k. (+ = kwenda mbele, - = kwenda nyuma).

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lisalo lya maboko. Ita na muundo [A+] / [B-].

game_message.solved: Mashinyi makunze adi enda kule, udi ujikija tshilumbu.
